audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly says Warwick's Q heal 'scales with your missing health' (spikes[0].text, whys[3], wants.you[0], wants.foe[0], early). That is wrong on both halves. Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on the target's MAXIMUM health and heals for the damage dealt — your health bar does not change it. The health-gated mechanics are Eternal Hunger (he heals only below 50%, tripled below 25%) and Blood Hunt (he hunts YOU below 50%, tripled below 25%).
audit.why: Because Q is max-health based, stacking raw HP feeds it — the correct answer is resists plus Grievous Wounds, which the page never states despite the missing-interactions file flagging exactly that. And the real reason to stay healthy is Blood Hunt marking, not a weaker Q heal.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now states max-health scaling, the no-raw-HP rule, and the 50% Blood Hunt line; whys[3], early, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0] rewritten to the real 50% thresholds; dosFull[2].d names the actual heal-for-damage-dealt mechanic and Bramble Vest.
sources: enemyKit Q (maximum health, heals for damage dealt, percentHealth flag)

edits.before: Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable head-on. Warwick must dodge E forever or find a jungler — punish the first mistake with R.
edits.after: Two items give him triple-strength healing under 25% and an R pick threat on your carries — group, build Bramble, and never fight him isolated.

edits.before: Warwick's Q heal scales with your missing health, so trade when you're healthy: Q the ground, W-shred him, and E-flip when he tries to stick with his passive move-speed. Bramble later, but even now your poke out-paces his Jaws sustain at full HP.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast scales off your maximum health, so raw HP is the wrong answer — build resists and Bramble instead. Stay above 50% and Blood Hunt never activates: Q the ground, W-shred, and hold E for the moment he lunges in.

edits.before: Warwick R (Infinite Duress) is a hard suppress from a fear-range dash — flash or E-flip out of it, and hold your own R to execute him if he commits and you survive the channel.
edits.after: Warwick R (Infinite Duress) is a 1.5s suppress on a leap, down 110s at rank 1 if he whiffs — break it with your E before he lands, not after, then execute him on the recovery.

edits.before: At 4-5 you keep out-trading his missing-health-scaled Jaws heal.
edits.after: At 4-5 you out-trade him while he is above 50% and unhunted.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours — Warwick's Q healing is weak when you're full health, so your auto-Q poke and Echoing Flames chunk him without giving him a sustain payoff. Keep your own HP high, deny him reasons to trade, and shove the wave to keep him off Blood-Hunt resets.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours — Eternal Hunger only heals Warwick below 50% health, so while he is topped up your auto-Q poke and Echoing Flames chunk him for free. Keep your own HP above 50% so Blood Hunt never marks you, and shove the wave to keep him off resets.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

notes: The old text told the player to 'flash or E-flip out of' Infinite Duress. Whether Flash or a dash can be used during the suppression is not in Riot's text, so I did not assert it either way — I rewrote the advice to be pre-emptive (spend E on the leap, before it lands), which is correct regardless. Also unverified and left alone: whether Urgot's E-flip interrupts Warwick's R leap mid-flight.
